item.title: City of Greater Geraldton rejects motion to spend $180k on Point Moore cottage so it can be staff housing
item.description: A bid by the city’s deputy mayor to spend $180,000 of ratepayers’ funds to remove asbestos from a Point Moore beach cottage so it could be used as “transitional” staff housing has failed.

item.title: City of Greater Geraldton awards $2 million tender to Safe Roads WA to widen Allanooka Springs Road
item.description: The City of Greater Geraldton council has awarded a $2 million contract to widen a 14.5km section of Allanooka Springs Road.

item.title: Consumer Watch with Candice Evans: Unit pricing hack to help your dollar go further when grocery shopping
item.description: Grocery shopping is a fact of life, and with cost-of-living pressures continuing to bite, many people are spending more time hunting for ways to stretch their shopping dollars further.

item.title: Geraldton’s Rigters Group will match customer donations in-store to BlazeAid Australia until end of February
item.description: A Geraldton business is urging its customers to get behind a worthy cause, launching a fundraiser to help those affected by Australia’s summer of bushfires.

item.title: Funding uncertainty surrounds Shore Leave festival as new timing, events and format flagged for 2026
item.description: Uncertainty surrounds one of the Mid West’s signature events, with a lack of funding secured so far for the 2026 Shore Leave festival.

item.title: Indigenous athletes soar to new heights being scouted for further representation and development opportunities
item.description: A group of Indigenous athletes have been identified for further development and representative opportunities after a stellar run at the Athletics Country Championships in Albany last month.

item.title: Geraldton Water Polo Association round 14: Demons and B52’s stamp authority on women's competition
item.description: Demons wasted no time stamping their authority in the women’s A-grade water polo on Saturday, delivering a composed and clinical 12-5 victory over Serpents under the bright midday sun.

item.title: Geraldton Softball Association round 13: Competition thinks pink as the association hosts annual Pink Round
item.description: Pink was front and centre around the diamonds in round 13 of the Geraldton softball season, with clubs coming together for the annual Pink Round in support of the McGrath Foundation.

item.title: Carnarvon man fined for animal cruelty after refusing to euthanise his dog suffering from tetanus
item.description: A Carnarvon man has been fined for animal cruelty after failing to treat his dog’s severe tetanus, leaving the canine to suffer to the point where euthanasia was the only humane option.

item.title: Brooke Narelle Hicks: 47-year-old mother jailed for three years over fatal hit-and-run that killed 19-year-old
item.description: A woman jailed over a fatal hit-and-run on Indian Ocean Drive that killed a 19-year-old lost her ‘grip on humanity’ when she fled the scene and failed to report the accident, according to a judge.
